newsitem.title: UK: United Utilities to change pay plan-paper.
newsitem.headline: United Utilities to change pay plan-paper.

text.p: United Utilities Plc has proposed changes to its long-term incentive pay scheme for executive, the Financial Times said on Friday.
The paper said the changes were designed to placate shareholders who threatened to reject the plan last year.

After further consultations with shareholders, United Utilities plans to compare its performance against other utility groups as well as the FTSE 100 share index. It also will base its short-term awards on the current year and not on a three-year rolling average, the paper said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
